title: Albemarle Q1 2026 results exhibit
excerpt: Q1 2026 adjusted EBITDA was USD 664 million; operating cash flow was USD 346 million and company-defined free cash flow was USD 248 million.
summary: The unchanged SEC-hosted exhibit remains Albemarle's latest reported operating evidence. It confirms lithium price and volume recovery, wide commodity-scenario sensitivity, liquidity, debt reduction, capex demands, and mandatory-convertible dilution, but does not provide probability-weighted normalized common-equity value.
